findings.observation: Existing medium native Calendar toolbar shows 编 / 辑 in Chinese and Bear- / beiten in German. This is excluded from full-header typography acceptance; popup position and complete date/body are the reviewed scope.
findings.executionLimit: Done has native medium-presentation AX scaling from44 to42.356; actual close tap passed in the complete normal iteration. Custom prompt/menu action target assertions remain44pt, recorded separately by test execution.

limitations: All16 unique original PNGs were actually opened with view_image. Six exact SHA256 duplicate captures reuse the matching original review; no image was altered.
Global prompts are centered in the system safe-area context, which can be6.5pt asymmetric relative to the physical window; no physical-center equality is inferred from pixels.
AssistiveTouch overlays are recorded per image; covered background/body-edge pixels are excluded from full visibility claims.
Custom44pt hit-target and dismiss/persistence behavior are execution assertions, not facts inferred solely from rendered screenshots.
These images establish ordinary-text Chinese-light/German-dark scope only; no maximum-text, whole-App or whole-header typography claim.
The offline fixture intentionally produces network failure for share-error presentation; it is not live share/backend success.
